hooks.command: p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; wf=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink "$p/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null)")"); if [ -x "$wf/hooks/git-guardrails" ]; then exec "$wf/hooks/git-guardrails"; fi; exit 0
p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; wf=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink "$p/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null)")"); if [ -x "$wf/hooks/push-na-commit" ]; then exec "$wf/hooks/push-na-commit"; fi; exit 0

p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; doel=$(readlink "$p/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$doel" ]; then exit 0; fi; wf=$(dirname "$(dirname "$doel")"); if [ ! -d "$wf" ]; then echo "Waarschuwing: .claude/settings.json wijst naar een map die niet bestaat ($wf) — draai adopt.sh opnieuw vanaf de huidige checkout. Tot dan draaien er geen hooks/guardrails."; exit 0; fi; if [ -x "$wf/pending-changes.sh" ]; then "$wf/pending-changes.sh" "$p" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" != "main" ] && git -C "$p" push origin HEAD 2>&1 || true
